messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Execution gets stuck at Warm-up phase
parts:
This may be related to another problem Daniel and Rob just
tracked down with Ben's help --- we were very strict in our
symmetry conditions for cov_matrix parameters. We've relaxed
that in a branch, but haven't released the fixed version yet.
So things might work in the current dev branch (I think that
fix got merged).

But what you really want to do is reformulate your model
in terms of a cholesky factor of a correlation matrix rather
than in terms of a cov_matrix parameter W. There's a section
in the regression chapter of the language manual that works
through an example. We're recommending the LKJ priors on correlation
matrices along with independently scaled variances.

I didn't work through seeing if all the Jacobians got accounted
for in your change of variables for the Wishart (I would've thought
using a loop index in a parameter, as in your chi_square, would be
wrong if I hadn't seen Ben doing it in our transform code).

We have an open feature request to fill in the Wishart and inverse
Wishart for Cholesky factors of covariance matrices, but we don't
have it yet.

There are other improvements you can make for efficiency, but
I'd hang on until the model's working.

- Bob
